scripts.render-build: npm run build && mkdir -p bin && curl -fSL https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o bin/yt-dlp && chmod a+rx bin/yt-dlp && curl -fSL https://github.com/ffbinaries/ffbinaries-prebuilt/releases/download/v6.1/ffmpeg-6.1-linux-64.zip -o bin/ffmpeg.zip && unzip -o bin/ffmpeg.zip -d bin && rm -f bin/ffmpeg.zip && chmod a+rx bin/ffmpeg && curl -fSL https://github.com/ffbinaries/ffbinaries-prebuilt/releases/download/v6.1/ffprobe-6.1-linux-64.zip -o bin/ffprobe.zip && unzip -o bin/ffprobe.zip -d bin && rm -f bin/ffprobe.zip && chmod a+rx bin/ffprobe
